evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment cartilage: Cartilage heterogeneity along the inner weightbearing tibial and femoral articular surfaces. Near full-thickness of cartilage fissuring along the anterior weightbearing femoral articular surface
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: Near full-thickness cartilage defect along the posterior nonweightbearing lateral femoral articular surface
evidence.PF OA: Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: High-grade chondrosis with complete cartilage loss along the lateral patellar facet and trochlear groove
evidence.Contusion: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
evidence.Fracture: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
